claims.subject: dawnhart_coven

evidence.quote: Katilda and the Dawnhart Coven believe she can use a spell to restore the day-night balance, but it's going to require activating the Celestus.
"Together, we can draw on our collective strength beneath the Celestus and, through it, restore the balance."
The Dawnhart Coven believes the festival is crucial to performing a ritual that would restore the balance of day and night on Innistrad.

claims.summary: Katilda and the Dawnhart Coven plan a Harvesttide ritual at the Celestus to restore Innistrad's day-night balance.

claims.subject: moonsilver_key

evidence.quote: To do that, a mechanism called the Sungold Lock in the center of the Celestus needs to be joined with an enchanted, blessed-silver item called the Moonsilver Key.
Unfortunately, the Moonsilver Key has been lost for generations . . .

claims.summary: Activating the Celestus requires joining the Moonsilver Key with the Sungold Lock at its center; the key had been lost for generations.

claims.subject: tovolar

evidence.quote: Driven by a fierce pride in werewolf-kind, he seeks to unify all the howlpacks under his rule.
Once he has a powerful pack behind him, he'll stop the Dawnhart Coven and anyone else who wants to bring back the sun.

claims.summary: The werewolf Tovolar seeks to unify the howlpacks and to stop the Dawnhart Coven from bringing back the sun.

claims.subject: olivia_voldaren

evidence.quote: Within that streak: Olivia Voldaren.
Katilda's body hangs limp in her arms.

claims.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the Harvesttide ritual at the Celestus and seizes Katilda.

claims.subject: olivia_voldaren

evidence.quote: There's an answer, of course—because Olivia stole the key—but Arlinn's not inclined to reason with her just now.
Besides, it was Olivia Voldaren who stole the Moonsilver Key.

claims.summary: Olivia Voldaren steals the Moonsilver Key after the interrupted ritual.

claims.subject: olivia_voldaren

evidence.quote: Olivia announces, "I present to you my handsome, perfect betrothed: Lord Edgar Markov."
The Lady of our most illustrious house, Olivia Voldaren, has pledged her heart to Edgar Markov, and he, his undying affections to her.

claims.summary: Olivia Voldaren announces Edgar Markov as her betrothed, and the two are wed at Voldaren Estate.
claims.limitation: Recorded with the closest existing relation, spouse_of. The quotes show the betrothal and wedding vows; the episodes end with the wedding disrupted, so whether the marriage stands afterwards is not graded.

claims.subject: edgar_markov

evidence.quote: Sorin, young then, approached his grandfather with his discovery.
Of all the wounds Sorin bore, Edgar had inflicted the first, and still, Sorin had loved him for thousands of years.

claims.summary: Edgar Markov is Sorin Markov's grandfather.

claims.subject: sorin_markov

evidence.quote: In the end, it is Edgar who falls from the rumble first, scrambling backward, his sword clattering to the ground like a toy.
Sorin scowls. "Go. Get out of my sight."

claims.summary: At the wedding, Sorin beats Edgar in a sword fight but spares him and lets him flee.

claims.subject: olivia_voldaren

evidence.quote: But that's nothing compared to what'll happen if Olivia gains control over all of Innistrad's angels.

claims.summary: Olivia's use of the Moonsilver Key threatened to give her control over Innistrad's angels.
claims.limitation: Stated from Arlinn's point of view as the stakes of the chase; Olivia's own plan is not narrated in that sentence.

claims.subject: olivia_voldaren

evidence.quote: But she drops the key. It clatters, without much ceremony, against the floor.
Olivia's already taken off through one of the windows. Edgar soon follows.

claims.summary: Cornered by Arlinn and the wolves, Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key and flees with Edgar.

claims.subject: dawnhart_coven

evidence.quote: Raised by the joined magic of the Dawnhart Coven, the Moonsilver Key floats toward the Sungold Lock.
A blacksmith's daughter stands beneath an ancient device and watches day return to Innistrad.
Together they watch the first sunrise over Innistrad in months.

claims.summary: The coven completes the Celestus ritual with the recovered key, and day returns to Innistrad: the first sunrise in months.

claims.subject: teferi

evidence.quote: In Teferi's hand is the Moonsilver Key.
"She's been kind enough to lend me the key. Moonsilver has a number of fascinating properties, particularly for temporal magic."

claims.summary: Katilda lends Teferi the Moonsilver Key after the ritual, for its usefulness to temporal magic.

claims.subject: odric

evidence.quote: Odric kept his eyes fixed on Henrika, knowing that she was not satisfied
Henrika's lips parted as she smiled, revealing the sharpened fangs behind them.

claims.summary: Odric faces the fanged Henrika in the chapel.
claims.limitation: 'Confronted' summarises the scene; the page's later outcome is not claimed.

claims.subject: wilhelt

evidence.quote: At the head of his column of the dead, Wilhelt marched on Thraben

claims.summary: Wilhelt leads a column of the dead against Thraben.

claims.subject: geralf

evidence.quote: Geralf would never let her hear the end of it if she died before he did!
as you are both the only brother I have

claims.summary: Gisa calls Geralf her only brother.
claims.limitation: The 'only brother' line is a letter whose speaker is inferred from context.

claims.subject: liesa

evidence.quote: Liesa yanked her spear free with a twist, ripping through the heavy neck to tear the Buried Lord's head from his body entirely.

claims.summary: Liesa beheads the Buried Lord.

claims.subject: jacob_hauken

evidence.quote: Perplexed, Jacob nods briefly at Lord Nellick before following Wicker down the hall.
Wicker—Eloise—barely rounds out five feet tall

claims.summary: Jacob Hauken investigates alongside Detective Eloise Wicker.
claims.limitation: The surname Hauken is taken from the page's name list; the page mostly says 'Jacob'.

claims.subject: arlinn_kord

evidence.quote: So, she followed, and when at last Tovolar pointed out the bodies to her, she did her best not to vomit.

claims.summary: Arlinn once followed Tovolar's pack.
claims.limitation: 'She' is Arlinn by point-of-view narration in a remembered scene.

claims.subject: adeline

evidence.quote: Adeline's commands come swift and certain as does the cut of her blade.
Adeline and the cathars spread in a circle around Arlinn and Worrin.

claims.summary: Adeline commands the cathars at House Betzold.
claims.limitation: The page shows her commanding this cathar company, not the whole order.

claims.subject: adeline

evidence.quote: Adeline, already mounted, throws out a hand for Chandra and helps her into the saddle.

claims.summary: Adeline helps Chandra into the saddle at the Harvesttide fight.

claims.subject: vadrik

evidence.quote: Do a simple job, get home to his husband Hailin.
Vadrik had never heard his husband sing this particular one.

claims.summary: Vadrik's husband is Hailin.
claims.limitation: The first line's 'his' is Vadrik by point-of-view narration.

claims.subject: leinore

evidence.quote: And from the look on Sinnia's face, she knew her sister would remember what had happened tonight forever.

claims.summary: Leinore and Sinnia are sisters.

claims.subject: elamon

evidence.quote: Torens stood up, smiled, and approached his savior: his older brother Elamon

claims.summary: Elamon is Torens's older brother.

claims.subject: odric

evidence.quote: But once Odric was ousted from his place on the Lunarch Council

claims.summary: Odric held a place on the Lunarch Council before being ousted.
claims.limitation: Former membership only: he was ousted.

claims.subject: wrenn

evidence.quote: without Wrenn's natural magic feeding his own

claims.summary: Wrenn's natural magic feeds Teferi's spellwork.
claims.limitation: 'Aided' is an editorial reading of the magic-sharing scene.

remaining: MID episodes 2-4 (Tovolar's pack, House Betzold, the Harvesttide festival) are only lightly used
Chandra and Adeline, Kaya's ghost work and Sorin's alchemy backstory in VOW Episode 1 are not modelled
Tovolar's turn to helping Arlinn in VOW Episode 5 is not graded
